# Northwind Bikes

> Northwind Bikes is a fictional bike shop selling three models (trail, city, kids). Orders ship within two working days and returns are accepted within 30 days.

## Products

- [All products](products.html): the three models with prices
- [Northwind Trail 29](product-trail.html): hardtail mountain bike, $1299
- [Northwind City 7](product-city.html): commuter bike, $749
- [Northwind Kids 20](product-kids.html): children's bike, $329

## Policies

- [Return policy](returns.html): 30-day returns, prepaid labels
- [Privacy policy](privacy.html): what data is collected and why
- [Terms of service](terms.html): orders, delivery, warranty
